ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The main structure in the figure is an R-substituted nitrogen atom; the nitrogen is also connected to H and is connected to a carbonyl carbon; this carbonyl carbon is double-bonded to an oxygen and single-bonded to a hydroxy oxygen O-H. On the right there is also an independent base labeled :B. The curved arrows in the figure indicate electron transfer, but the problem requires ignoring the arrows. Reasoning: After ignoring the arrows, only the atomic connectivity is retained, and the main fragment is R-NH-C(=O)-OH. R is an unspecified substituent and is represented by the wildcard * in SMILES, so the main fragment is written as *NC(=O)O. The :B on the right is not bonded to the main fragment and is written as [B] as an independent component. Two unconnected components are connected with a dot, so the SMILES is *NC(=O)O.[B].

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First describe the image chemically: ignore all curved arrows as instructed, then transcribe only the atom connectivity. The main fragment is R-NH-C(=O)-OH, where R is an unspecified substituent attached to nitrogen. Convert R to the SMILES wildcard `*`, write the N-C(=O)-O skeleton as `NC(=O)O`, and add the separate base label `:B` as an unconnected component `[B]`. Join disconnected components with a dot to obtain `*NC(=O)O.[B]`.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中主要结构是一个 R 取代的氮原子，氮上还连有 H，并与羰基碳相连；该羰基碳与一个氧双键相连，同时与一个羟基氧 O-H 单键相连。右侧还有一个独立的标记为 :B 的碱。图中的弯曲箭头表示电子转移，但题目要求忽略箭头。推理：忽略箭头后，只保留原子连接关系，主片段为 R-NH-C(=O)-OH。R 是未指定取代基，在 SMILES 中用通配符 * 表示，因此主片段写作 *NC(=O)O。右侧的 :B 与主片段不成键，作为独立组分写作 [B]。两个不连接的组分用点号连接，所以 SMILES 为 *NC(=O)O.[B]。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is the direct structure-to-SMILES route; it relies on reading the drawn atoms and connectivity while explicitly excluding the curved arrows and treating R as a wildcard substituent. No alternative genuinely different route is needed for this single depicted structure.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the molecular drawing: an R group bonded to N; N bears H and is single-bonded to a carbonyl carbon; that carbon is double-bonded to O and single-bonded to an O that bears H, giving R-NH-C(=O)-OH. Also note a separate base fragment labeled :B near the acidic H, with arrows indicating electron movement but no drawn bond to the molecule.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question instruction that asks for the SMILES expression of the shown transition-state structure and specifically says to ignore the arrows.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES conventions: represent an unspecified R attachment as wildcard `*`, encode the carbamic acid fragment as `*NC(=O)O`, omit hydrogens that are implicit in SMILES, and represent the disconnected base as a separate component `[B]` separated by a dot. Curved arrows are mechanistic annotations, not bonds or atoms.
